title: Flat meets functional: face-to-face 2D/2D S-scheme photocatalysts for efficient CO2-to-fuel conversion
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00754B, Review Article
Parul Rana, Pardeep Singh, Vanita Puri, Quyet Van Le, Tansir Ahamad, Thi Thu Le, Van-Huy Nguyen, Pankaj Raizada
This review highlights face-to-face 2D/2D S-scheme photocatalysts for CO2 reduction, focusing on charge transfer, interfacial design, and performance and offering insights into improving photocatalytic efficiency through material engineering.
